alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:e5ea31d5-a.title: Sales Development Manager
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:e5ea31d5-a.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We're hiring a Sales Development Manager to lead the team of SDRs generating pipeline for our North American sales org. You'll own the day-to-day leadership of the team — coaching reps, aligning with AEs and sales leadership, holding a high bar on execution, hiring, and building the systems that make the team consistently productive. Our market is new and evolves by the day, and our buyers are hyper-technical. Prospecting at Baseten means earning credibility with that audience, and coaching a team to do it at scale. The right person for this role is a coach and a builder — someone who gets energy from developing people, is obsessive about execution, and wants to define what world-class pipeline generation looks like when the product, the buyers, and the sales motion are all AI-native. RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs responsible for opening doors with the next wave of Baseten customers. - Own the team's pipeline generation targets and drive consistent execution against weekly, monthly, and quarterly goals. - Build and refine outbound strategies, messaging, and frameworks across a wide range of accounts, tuned to a technical audience. - Run 1:1s, team meetings, training, and pipeline reviews that make reps measurably better week over week. - Partner with AEs and sales managers on account strategy, lead quality, and handoff processes. - Analyze pipeline data to identify what's working, diagnose what's not, and change it fast. - Hire and onboard new SDRs as the team grows, raising the talent bar with each hire. - Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Recruiting. - Build with AI — test new tools, automate repetitive work, and make your team faster and sharper than a team twice its size. REQUIREMENTS - 1-2+ years managing an SDR or BDR team at an enterprise-focused tech company, and 4+ years in tech overall. - Direct experience as an SDR and/or AE — you've done the job you're coaching. - Technical aptitude and real curiosity about AI infrastructure. You should be able to hold your own in a conversation about inference and want to get deeper. - A track record of top performance and progression in fast-paced, results-driven environments. - Strong coaching instincts — you'd rather be in the trenches on calls and messaging with your reps than managing by dashboard. - Comfort with data and systems. You can pull a report, spot a trend, and turn it into a coaching conversation or a process change. - Hands-on with AI in your own workflow — you've built, adopted, or experimented your way to a faster prospecting motion, and you can show us. - A builder's mentality. You own problems and their solutions, and you're at your best in high-change, fast-moving environments. BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. angellist-angellist:lever:e0c43af6-5bc2-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. As an Account Executive you will source, qualify and close venture & private equity funds for AngelList Fund Management or Software Suite. This role provides a unique opportunity to work alongside experienced leaders in the private market industry and shape AngelList’s sales strategy in this next phase of our growth. Given AngelList’s easy-to-use and scalable solution, you will have the opportunity to have an outsized impact not just on our company, but on the private market industry as a whole. You will manage the entire sales cycle, including creating and executing on outbound processes to close a pipeline of customers. As an early member of the sales team, you’ll be critical in helping us iterate on our pitch and processes as we scale. Internally, you will collaborate with AngelList’s product, operations, and legal teams to ensure a smooth experience for our users. We are a fast-growing company, so we need Venture Account Executives who will take initiative, learn our product quickly and thoroughly, and bring a growth mindset to their work each day.

emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:e25f2923-33ce-45.description: About The Role We're looking for a Growth PM who can own the next chapter of how Alchemy grows. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role at the intersection of product, engineering, and go-to-market — and the surface area is expanding fast. Our AI agent platform lets autonomous software create wallets, pay for API access in real time, and operate fully on-chain, opening up an entirely new category of user to acquire, activate, and retain. You'll bring structure to ambiguity, move fast, and build something that compounds. You'll have full end-to-end ownership of the growth motion — strategy, experimentation, and the number. You'll have a direct line to leadership, high visibility across the org, and the resources to move fast and make a real dent. What You'll Do - Own the full growth funnel — set the strategy, define the metrics, and drive acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion across our developer platform - Identify and build the compounding loops that turn great developer experience into organic growth — referrals, word of mouth, community, virality - Deeply instrument the product to understand where developers convert, where they drop off, and what moves the needle - Run a high-velocity experimentation program — rapid A/B tests, sharp hypotheses, and a relentless focus on finding what works - Unlock new growth channels: SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, PLG motions — and figure out which bets compound fastest at our scale - Open up an entirely new growth surface: AI agents are becoming first-class users of developer platforms, and nobody has cracked how to acquire, activate, and retain them yet What we're looking for - 4+ years in product, 2–3+ with true end-to-end ownership of growth — you've moved a metric that mattered and can show your work - Deep growth craft — funnel analysis, cohort modeling, experimentation design, channel strategy. You think in loops, not campaigns - Experience with developer-facing or API-first products — Web2 (Stripe, Twilio, Vercel) or Web3, fluency in either translates - Analytical and decisive — you build models fast, pressure-test assumptions, and act on signal - Strong enough to align engineering, marketing, and sales around a growth motion without direct authority Benefits and Perks: 🩺 Medical, Dental, & Vision 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks 📚 Learning & Development Stipend 🎉 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events 💸 HSA and FSA Plans 🧬 Fertility Benefits More on the Role Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:97e5.description: Job Summary: The Traveling Commercial Roofing Superintendent is responsible for overseeing and managing commercial roofing projects from start to finish, ensuring quality, safety, and productivity standards are met. This role supervises crews, coordinates job site activities, and ensures projects are completed on time and within scope. Responsibilities include new installations, re-roofing, repairs, and maintenance of commercial roofing systems, including TPO, PVC, EPDM, modified bitumen, and metal roofing systems. The Superintendent will also be responsible for quality control, safety compliance, and customer communication across multiple job sites. This position requires travel to project sites across Texas, including Amarillo, Abilene, and San Antonio, as well as Monroe, Louisiana. Flynn provides housing accommodations. What We Offer • Competitive salary: $90,000 – $110,000 annually (DOE) • Multiple wage reviews throughout the year • Comprehensive PAID benefits – health, dental, and vision • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance • Life and AD&D Insurance • 401k with company match • Company-provided smartphone and computer • Opportunities for career advancement • Training, mobile apps, and development programs through Flynn University What We Are Seeking • 2+ years of superintendent experience in commercial roofing (REQUIRED) • Strong hands-on knowledge of commercial roofing systems: TPO, PVC, EPDM, Modified Bitumen, metal roofing, and coatings • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, specifications, and project plans • Experience managing crews, subcontractors, and job site operations • Strong understanding of safety practices, OSHA compliance, and job site procedures • Ability to perform inspections, identify issues (leaks, defects), and implement repairs • Experience with installation of insulation, vapor barriers, flashing, and waterproofing systems • Proficiency with tools and equipment such as hot air welders, hand torches, spray equipment, compressors, and power tools • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (required) • Open to traveling for extended periods Key Responsibilities • Supervise and coordinate all roofing activities on job sites • Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget • Lead and mentor crews while maintaining productivity and quality standards • Conduct site inspections and ensure compliance with project specifications • Communicate regularly with project managers, clients, and team members • Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting • Enforce safety protocols and company policies at all times #LI-DNI 05/22/26

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:d8b852b5-f083-421.description: ABOUT ABACUS Abacus is reinventing how accounting firms operate by building AI agents that automate the tedious, repetitive workflows that teams currently face. Our core engine combines advanced OCR and LLMs to deliver truly intelligent back-office automation. We're already working with large enterprise clients, generating meaningful revenue, and backed by top-tier investors. We’ve accomplished all of this as a team of two, and we’re excited to grow our team. If you want to shape the future of AI-powered operations and own meaningful technical work from day one, this is the place. The Role We're hiring our first Founding Engineer to own and expand the core machine learning engine behind Abacus. You’ll report directly to the co-founders and work in person from our SF office. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth company as an early engineer with massive autonomy and influence over product and technical direction. What You’ll Do - Lead development of our ML-powered document extraction engine - Architect backend systems with performance and scalability in mind - Build and deploy new automation features for tax firms - Collaborate closely with the founders on product and user needs - Help define our engineering culture and technical roadmap What We're Looking For Must-haves: - 1–5 years of experience, ideally in high-ownership or early-stage environments - Strong backend development skills, particularly in Python - Proven 0→1 builder (side projects, startup experience, or both) - Willingness to work from our SF office, 5 days/week - Willingness to complete a technical take-home exercise as part of the process Nice-to-haves: - Experience with LLMs, OCR, or data extraction systems - Exposure to AI infrastructure or evaluation frameworks Why Join Us - No ceiling on ownership or growth - Significant equity and high-leverage role at a fast-growing startup - Top-tier health insurance, daily lunches, and an in-office barista - You’ll help define the trajectory of the product, team, and company!
